title: VISTA: Steering LLMs with Latent User Values Inferred from a Few Survey Answers
abstract: arXiv:2610.23702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalizing a language model requires knowing what a person values, which stays largely consistent across tasks. Yet most methods either learn task-specific preferences or place the user's profile in the prompt, where models struggle to act on it. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Steering and Targeted Acquisition), which infers a latent profile from users' (full or partial) survey answers, and maps the profile through a hypernetwork to a user-specific steering intervention in a frozen LLM to select answer choices or generate free-text responses. Given the same evidence, VISTA matches or beats in-context profiles on synthetic preferences (Food2D), the World Values Survey (WVS), and PrimeX, without adding prompt tokens. translated_title: VISTA：利用从少量调查答案中推断的潜在用户价值观来引导大语言模型
translated_abstract: 个性化语言模型需要了解一个人的价值观，而这种价值观在不同任务间基本保持一致。然而，现有方法要么学习特定任务的偏好，要么将用户画像放在提示词中，而模型难以据此采取行动。我们提出了VISTA（Value-Informed Steering and Targeted Acquisition，基于价值观的引导与针对性获取），它从用户的（完整或部分）调查答案中推断出潜在画像，并通过超网络将该画像映射为冻结大语言模型中针对特定用户的引导干预，以选择答案选项或生成自由文本回复。在相同证据条件下，VISTA在合成偏好数据（Food2D）、世界价值观调查（WVS）和PrimeX上的表现与基于上下文的用户画像相当或更优，且不增加提示词token。为了减少完成完整问卷的认知负担，VISTA还能选择要询问哪些问题以及何时停止：在WVS上，它在仅回答6%的问卷后即停止，同时保留了完整历史数据增益的94%。
tldr: VISTA通过从少量调查答案推断用户的潜在价值观，并利用超网络将其转化为冻结大语言模型中的个性化引导干预，无需在提示词中放置用户画像即可实现与甚至超越上下文画像的个性化效果，且仅询问6%的问卷即可保留94%的完整信息增益。
en_tdlr: VISTA infers users' latent values from a few survey answers and maps them via a hypernetwork to user-specific steering interventions in a frozen LLM, matching or beating in-context profiles without extra prompt tokens, and retaining 94% of the full-history gain by asking only 6% of the questionnaire.
